/* WRAPPER */
.amt-wrapper{
max-width:1320px;
margin:0 auto;
padding:70px 20px;
}

/* TITLES */
.section-title{
font-size:44px;
font-weight:700;
margin-bottom:10px;
}

.section-subtitle{
font-size:17px;
color:#666;
max-width:900px;
margin-bottom:40px;
}

/* GRID */
.amt-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
gap:22px;
}

/* CARD */
.amt-card{
background:#fff;
border-radius:24px;
padding:34px;
border:1px solid #eee;
box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
transition:0.25s ease;
}

.amt-card:hover{
transform:translateY(-4px);
box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}

.amt-card.large{
grid-column:span 2;
}

/* TEXT */
.amt-card h2{
font-size:30px;
margin-bottom:16px;
}

.amt-card h3{
font-size:22px;
margin-bottom:12px;
}

.amt-card p{
font-size:15.5px;
color:#555;
margin-bottom:12px;
}

.highlight{
color:#ff6b00;
font-weight:600;
}

/* IMAGES — ВАЖНО: НЕ ТРОГАЛ */
.amt-card img{
width:100%;
border-radius:16px;
margin:16px 0;
display:block;
}

/* INFOGRAPHIC */
.infogrid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
gap:12px;
margin-top:12px;
}

.info{
background:#fafafa;
border:1px solid #eee;
border-radius:14px;
padding:16px;
text-align:center;
}

/* ОРАНЖЕВЫЙ ГРАДИЕНТ ТОЛЬКО ДЛЯ ЦИФР */
.big-number{
font-size:42px;
font-weight:800;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff6b00,#ffb36b);
-webkit-background-clip:text;
-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
display:block;
margin-bottom:6px;
}

/* LIST */
ul{
padding-left:18px;
}

li{
margin-bottom:10px;
color:#555;
}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:992px){
.amt-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.amt-card.large{grid-column:span 1;}
}

@media(max-width:768px){
.section-title{font-size:32px;}
.amt-card{padding:24px;}
}
